title: Data and code for a critical review of column generation and branch-and-price acceleration

creators.name: Xinran Yang
creators.affiliation: School of Management and Engineering, Capital University of Economics and Business, China

version_doi: assigned by Zenodo when this version is published
description: Coded inventory of 113 method variants (58 traditional, 55 learning-guided) from 70 core or supporting study families, drawn from a full-text frame of 100 families (80 core, 8 supporting, 12 background). Includes the Figure 3 and Figure A.1 data, Table 4 source locators, Supplementary Tables S1 and S2, retained search and screening records, a codebook, an independent re-coding pack with agreement code, and scripts that regenerate Figures 1-3 and A.1. The data describe a bounded critical sample and do not reproduce solver experiments of the source papers.
